patch.content:
# Default configuration for the native_posix board
#
# Copyright (c) 2017 Intel Corporation
#
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

CONFIG_BOARD_NATIVE_POSIX=y
CONFIG_ARCH_POSIX=y
CONFIG_POSIX_API=y

# Memory configuration
CONFIG_MAIN_STACK_SIZE=4096
CONFIG_SYSTEM_WORKQUEUE_STACK_SIZE=2048
CONFIG_HEAP_MEM_POOL_SIZE=32768

# Console and logging
CONFIG_CONSOLE_HANDLER=y
CONFIG_UART_CONSOLE=y
CONFIG_PRINTK=y
CONFIG_LOG=y
CONFIG_LOG_MODE_DEFERRED=y

# Test-related configurations
CONFIG_TEST_RANDOM_GENERATOR=y

# Multithreading and scheduling
CONFIG_MULTITHREADING=y
CONFIG_TIMESLICING=y
CONFIG_TIMESLICING_STACK_SIZE=1024
CONFIG_ISR_STACK_SIZE=2048

# External libc and native library for native_posix
CONFIG_EXTERNAL_LIBC=y
CONFIG_NATIVE_LIBRARY=y
